author: larpersader
quote: First 15 hours of the game you do chores. Everything is restricted and locked, and despite being a GTA game, it punishes you for wanting to do crimes. Jason has terrible writing and voice acting, the most boring character in any video game ever. Every line he says is just like "Yep", "Yeah", "Lucia Caminos" and not a single note worthy thing. He buys Lucia clothes, jewelry, fixes the house for her, and a bunch of other stuff, just for her to talk to other men whilst he's doing so, literally making him a genuine c*ck and making you play as one. You can't even try to rob certain cars, shoot a lot of certain NPCs because they didn't want to offend people (even though the whole reason why the first GTAs were popular was because it offended people). Despite being a game about committing crimes, it has an honor-like system that punishes you permanantly for committing said crimes, which would fit in other games where you redeem yourself (rdr2), but in a game about Grand THEFT Auto, you get punished permanently for doing said grand theft auto. There's barely any progression and you make like $0. Not to mention the 30 fps. Anybody who says this is a good game are only looking at the graphics and completely disregarding everything else. This game is not worth $100, just go buy the other older Rockstar games instead.
